topics.description: The shooting of Alex Pretti by Border Patrol agents in Minneapolis has sparked widespread protests and calls for investigation. The incident has raised concerns about the use of force by law enforcement and the handling of immigration cases.
topics.reason: Fatal shooting by Border Patrol agents

topics.description: There are growing concerns about child care fraud in Minnesota, with a single building linked to $380 million in Medicaid billing. This has raised questions about the oversight and regulation of child care services.
